description: Headset version of the M1 scenario: coc riverwood (one console command; a second arrives garbled), stand 10 s (idle), then run forward (run). FRAME NUMBERS ARE PLACEHOLDERS until `bench.py calibrate --device <udid>` shows when the main menu is up on the headset and how long the load takes; shift console_at, the phases, the keys, the shots and exit_frame together.
